name: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Yellow Toe'
story_html: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG ‘Yellow Toe’ also known as ‘Taxi’ brings back the distinctive color blocking of the AJ1 ‘Bred Toe’ from 2018. The all-leather upper combines a white quarter panel with a yellow toe box, black forefoot overlay, and black signature Swoosh. Additional hits of amber land on the heel overlay and collar flap, featuring a retro Wings logo stamped on the lateral side. A woven Nike Air tag graces the black nylon tongue. The high-top rests on a durable rubber cupsole, highlighted by white sidewalls and a yellow rubber outsole.
